headline: 27B at IQ2_S (MTP build) on a rebuilt box \u2014 Ryzen 3 2200G + RX 6700 XT 12 GB, llama.cpp Vulkan. FINAL VERIFIED STATE: 20,480 context, Q4_0 KV (Q8_0 KV at 20K died with ErrorDeviceLost ~145s), all layers GPU-resident, MTP speculative decoding active (draft acceptance ~0.63), --reasoning-budget 8192 required to make the uncapped-thinking games finish inside the window. Generation measured 17-18.5 tok/s across the games.
facts: ryzen3090.local (strata, rebuilt Oct 2026): AMD Ryzen 3 2200G (4C/4T), 16 GB DDR4-2133, Radeon RX 6700 XT 12 GB, Windows 11
llama-server (llama.cpp-win-x86_64-vulkan-avx2 2.64.0) run directly via Windows scheduled task; LM Studio's own server stopped for the run (lms load exposes no KV-cache-type knob)

IQ2_S-mtp loads fully GPU-resident at 20,480 ctx with q4_0 KV (~10.6 GB working set). 16,384 ctx with default f16/Q8_0 KV did not fit (LM Studio estimate); 20,480/Q8_0 loaded then died mid-run with Vulkan ErrorDeviceLost at ~145 s
cache-type-k/v q4_0 + kv_unified + kv-offload, flash-attn on — survived a 13,000-token stress generation (HTTP 200, 577 s, no device-lost)
MTP draft-mtp, draft-n-max 3: acceptance 0.627, mean accepted length 2.88 → ~17-18.5 tok/s measured

server default put every intermediate token in the reasoning channel; --reasoning-budget 8192 + --no-reasoning-preserve was REQUIRED for breakout/delta/fractal to emit HTML in content at all (first 20K attempts produced 18-20K reasoning tokens and empty content)

observations.text: breakout: renders menu, space starts play, ball/paddle/bricks animate, keyboard+mouse respond, full game-over/retry loop. Defects: title glyphs clipped at left edge; game-over card collides with LIVES/BEST HUD. README prose after </html> was harness-extraction residue (fixed in extract_html), scored on the game itself.

delta: C64-tribute horizontal scroller; wave 1 spawns, ship fires bullets, enemies move, HUD (SCORE/HI/WAVE) updates, CRT bezel chrome. Defect: hand-coded pixel font lacks '/' and '%' glyphs (render as '?').

fractal: pan/zoom/sliders all responsive and the escape-time math runs (canvas pixel buffer changes on zoom: 89k→114k colored px, all alpha=255), but the colormap maps t=mu/maxIter so at 512 iterations nearly every pixel lands in the near-black palette end — both canvases look uniformly black to a human. Core feature visually broken despite correct structure.

Games ran 12-18 min each at ~18 tok/s; 20,480 ctx is the real ceiling here — delta finished at 19,323 tok, within ~1k of the window. Reference 3080 Ti row had 29,184 ctx on the same 12 GB card with Q8_0 KV and no thinking budget.

open: DDR4-2133 + 4 cores: CPU side is the bottleneck for prompt processing (long games queue ~0.5-1 min before first token)
